title: NeuroSpin hMT+ Localizer DATA (MEG & aMRI)
description: This magnetoencephalography (MEG) dataset comprises recordings from 10 participants performing a human visual motion area (hMT+) localizer task involving passive viewing of coherent and incoherent moving dot stimuli. The dataset includes concurrent anatomical MRI scans and auxiliary physiological recordings (EOG, ECG), formatted according to the MEG-BIDS standard. The data were collected to investigate supramodal processing and visual perceptual learning mechanisms.
methods_description: MEG data were acquired using a 306-channel Neuromag Elekta system at 2 kHz sampling rate with 0.03–600 Hz band-pass filtering. Head position was tracked using four HPI coils before each block, with anatomical reference via three fiducial markers. Participants passively viewed 120 trials of moving dot stimuli (50% coherent, 50% incoherent; 1500 ms duration per trial). Concurrent EOG and ECG recordings were obtained. Anatomical T1-weighted MRI was acquired on a 3-T Siemens Trio scanner (1.0 × 1.0 × 1.1 mm voxels; TR = 2300 ms; TE = 2.98 ms). Empty room recordings (5 min) were acquired for noise covariance estimation.
